channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Bruce Springsteen releases protest song ‘Streets of Minneapolis’
item.description: He excoriates ICE and promises to remember Renee Good and Alex Pretti.

item.title: Takeaways: Wolves dispatch short-handed Mavericks 118-105
item.description: Julius Randle had a standout performance in his native Dallas, recording his ninth 30-point game of the season.

item.title: A chaotic confrontation, a gun and 10 shots: A frame-by-frame analysis of the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti
item.description: The Minnesota Star Tribune analyzed how another encounter with federal agents turned deadly.

item.title: Minnesota elected officials talk immigration crackdown at CNN town hall
item.description: While the event offered calm compared to the inflamed recent rhetoric, the fundamental partisan fault lines remained.

item.title: Vance, Trump and Frey trade barbs on immigration over social media
item.description: After a “cordial conversation,” President Trump slammed Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey again, and Vice President JD Vance joined in on social media.

item.title: Star Tribune analysis: Feds disobeying judicial orders on immigration detainees
item.description: The federal government cites a glut in cases and low staffing as reasons for violating court orders.

item.title: Minneapolis police say FBI has taken over lead in investigating Ilhan Omar being sprayed with liquid
item.description: Anthony James Kazmierczak, 55, of Minneapolis remains jailed for allegedly spraying her during a Minneapolis town hall.

item.title: Feds bring assault charges against protesters and observers they say impeded immigration agents
item.description: U.S. Attorney General Pam Bondi said on social media, “We expect more arrests to come.”

item.title: Lawmakers visit 5-year-old Minnesota boy, who appeared ‘depressed’ in detention center
item.description: Reps. Joaquin Castro and Jasmine Crockett demanded that preschooler Liam Conejo Ramos and his father be released.

item.title: The latest: Alex Pretti involved in altercation with federal agents days before he was killed
item.description: Video shows Pretti being tackled by officers after he flipped his middle fingers at a vehicle carrying federal agents. An eyewitness said Pretti kicked out a taillight of the agents’ vehicle.
